1cd2d368-2fc5-4115-882f-e30948a597e4.Text: Ends the turn. Pick the direction you expect the enemy from. Until the start of your next turn, make one attack with your weapon against the first enemy that moves, is pushed or acts within your weapon's range, in any direction. The attack gets +10 hit chance straight ahead, falling to -30 if you have to spin all the way around (0 at 45°, -10 at 90°, -20 at 135°), and a further penalty that grows with distance, up to -33 at your weapon's full range, on top of your weapon's normal hit chance.

0b6da7d3-83c9-4576-8768-2708508ed113.Text: Ends the turn. Aim a cone: the farther you aim, the longer and narrower it gets, up to your weapon's range. Until the start of your next turn, attack enemies that move, are pushed or act inside it, once for each Action Point you had left. Fire is spread across different enemies first; an enemy already hit is only attacked again after it moves at least 2 cells. Attacks use your weapon's normal hit chance, with a snap-shot penalty that grows the farther the cone reaches, up to -30 at your weapon's range, on top of the normal range penalty.

4bd455eb-f1a0-4754-abb6-d18063a5d139.Text: Ends the turn. Pin down the target until the start of your next turn: each time it leaves its square, by moving, charging, jumping or being pushed, you make an attack against it with your weapon, using your weapon's normal hit chance. A long move draws one attack, not one per square. It can stay where it is and act without drawing fire.

bc63cd4b-4de3-49f9-bf67-09992c124939.Text: Pinned down. Each time this unit leaves its square, by moving, charging, jumping or being pushed, the suppressing attacker fires at it.

8e4f3ee9-93af-4e5c-9262-9b76604ff0b2.Text: Watching a cone. Each rank is one shot left at enemies that move, are pushed or act inside it.

640228ad-add2-44c5-a92a-9baaaceb3c43.Text: Standing in an Overwatch cone. Each rank is a percent penalty to the hit chance of a shot from that cone, on top of its normal range penalty.
